snapshot.title: Adjust section spacing and card alignment
snapshot.description:
Reduce vertical spacing between sections and align titles/descriptions across cards in sections like Benefits and Process Sections.
    
    Related: @doc/guides/docs-system-roadmap (maybe)
    
    1. Reduce section padding (py-16/py-24 -> py-12/py-16).
    2. Fix min-heights for card titles and descriptions to ensure horizontal alignment across rows.
    3. Tweak StandardSectionHeader padding.

newValue.text: Reduce vertical padding in sections (Process, Benefits, etc) to decrease overall page length.
Align titles horizontally across cards in Process section using min-height.
Align descriptions horizontally across cards in Process section using min-height.
Refine min-heights in Benefits section to ensure titles and descriptions align even with longer content.
